name.title: Accessory Name
name.description: Name shown in Apple Home for the solar production accessory

host.title: Envoy Address
host.description: IP address or hostname of the Enphase Envoy on your local network

protocol.title: Connection Protocol
protocol.description: Protocol used to connect to the Envoy

allowInsecureTLS.title: Allow Self-Signed HTTPS Certificate
allowInsecureTLS.description: Enable this if your Envoy uses a self-signed HTTPS certificate (most installations)

mode.title: Envoy API Endpoint
mode.description: Select which Envoy API endpoint is used to read production data

pollIntervalSeconds.title: Polling Interval
pollIntervalSeconds.description: How often the Envoy is queried for data, in seconds

onThresholdW.title: Production ON Threshold (W)
onThresholdW.description: Solar production level above which the Production Active sensor becomes active

offThresholdW.title: Production OFF Threshold (W)
offThresholdW.description: Solar production level below which the Production Active sensor becomes inactive

token.title: Authentication Token
token.description: Bearer token obtained from https://entrez.enphaseenergy.com (paste token only, without 'Bearer')

enableInverterLeakSensor.title: Enable Inverter Failure Monitoring
enableInverterLeakSensor.description: Expose a Leak Sensor in HomeKit that triggers when one or more inverters go offline

expectedInverters.title: Expected Number of Inverters
expectedInverters.description: If set to 0, the plugin automatically learns the inverter count from the first successful reading

inverterDebug.title: Inverter Debug Logging
inverterDebug.description: Log detailed information about inverter checks, data source and inverter counts

debugLogging.title: Production Debug Logging
debugLogging.description: Log solar production watts on every poll at debug level

debugBurstCount.title: Temporary Debug Burst
debugBurstCount.description: Log the next N polling cycles at info level, then stop automatically
